name: meo-enhanced
description: An enhanced Markdown editor with live editing mode for VS Code.

commands.title: MEO Enhanced: Reset Theme to Default

meoEnhanced.useAsDefault.description: Use MEO Enhanced as the default editor for Markdown files

enumDescriptions: Show the document outline on the left side of the editor.
Show the document outline on the right side of the editor.
meoEnhanced.outline.position.description: Position of the contents outline sidebar.

meoEnhanced.contentMaxWidth.visible.description: Constrain the editor content to a centered 800px column.

meoEnhanced.gitChanges.visible.description: Show change indicators in the editor.

meoEnhanced.gitBlame.enabled.description: Show Git author and commit details when hovering over lines in the change gutter.

enumDescriptions: Compare with the latest content saved to disk.
Compare with the version before the most recent save batch.
Compare with the file at Git HEAD.
meoEnhanced.changes.baseline.description: Choose the baseline used for change indicators.

meoEnhanced.gitChanges.lineHighlights.description: Show subtle line coloring for modified lines in Source mode.

meoEnhanced.spellCheck.enabled.description: Show built-in spelling diagnostics in MEO Enhanced when no external spell checker diagnostics are available.

enumDescriptions: Enable Vim emulation automatically when VSCodeVim (vscodevim.vim) is installed and enabled, or when VSCode Neovim (asvetliakov.vscode-neovim) is installed.
Always enable Vim emulation in MEO Enhanced.
Always disable Vim keybindings in MEO Enhanced.
meoEnhanced.vimMode.behavior.description: Controls Vim emulation in Source and Live mode.

meoEnhanced.codeBlocks.useVscodeTheme.description: Highlight fenced code blocks using your active VS Code color theme.

meoEnhanced.rememberPosition.lines.description: Markdown files with at least this many lines will remember the last viewed line and restore the scroll position when opened.

meoEnhanced.export.browserPath.description: Optional path to a Chrome/Edge executable used for browser-based export rendering (PDF and HTML finalize). Leave empty to auto-detect.

enumDescriptions: Embed local image files in exported HTML.
Keep local image links as relative paths in exported HTML.
meoEnhanced.export.html.imageMode.description: How local images are handled during HTML export.

meoEnhanced.imageFolder.description: Folder name to save pasted images (relative to workspace root).

defaultSnippets.label: HKK theme payload
defaultSnippets.description: Insert the full annotated-capable theme object with semantic Markdown/UI colors.
defaultSnippets.body:
{
	"id": "hkk",
	"name": "HKK",
	"backgroundColor": "var(--vscode-editor-background)",
	"colors": {
		"base01": "var(--vscode-editor-foreground)",
		"base02": "#676f7d",
		"base03": "#3e444d",
		"base04": "#e06c75",
		"base05": "#61afef",
		"base06": "#66d9ef",
		"base07": "#e5c07b",
		"base08": "#c678dd",
		"base09": "#98c379"
	},
	"syntaxTokens": {},
	"fonts": {
		"liveFont": "",
		"sourceFont": "",
		"liveFontWeight": "",
		"sourceFontWeight": "",
		"liveFontSize": null,
		"sourceFontSize": null,
		"h1FontSize": 1.6,
		"h2FontSize": 1.5,
		"h3FontSize": 1.3,
		"h4FontSize": 1.2,
		"h5FontSize": 1.1,
		"h6FontSize": 1,
		"h1FontWeight": "400",
		"h2FontWeight": "400",
		"h3FontWeight": "400",
		"h4FontWeight": "400",
		"h5FontWeight": "400",
		"h6FontWeight": "400",
		"liveLineHeight": 1.5,
		"sourceLineHeight": 1.5
	},
	"semanticColors": {
		"foreground": "var(--vscode-editor-foreground)",
		"mutedForeground": "#676f7d",
		"background": "var(--vscode-editor-background)",
		"surfaceBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-background) 86%, var(--meo-color-base03) 14%)",
		"insetBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-background) 80%, var(--meo-color-base03) 20%)",
		"selectionBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-color-base05) 28%, transparent 72%)",
		"activeLineBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-color-base03) 35%, transparent 65%)",
		"caret": "var(--vscode-editor-foreground)",
		"codeBlockBackground": "#1f2428",
		"codeBlockActiveLineBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-background) 88%, var(--meo-color-base03) 12%)",
		"codeLanguageLabelForeground": "#79b8ff",
		"codeLanguageLabelBackground": "transparent",
		"codeCopyForeground": "#79b8ff",
		"codeCopyBackground": "transparent",
		"codeCopyHoverForeground": "#79b8ff",
		"codeCopyHoverBackground": "var(--vscode-toolbar-hoverBackground)",
		"inlineCodeBackground": "#2a3a52",
		"tagForeground": "#61afef",
		"tagBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-color-base05) 14%, transparent 86%)",
		"tagBorder": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-color-base05) 38%, transparent 62%)",
		"orderedListMarker": "#79b8ff",
		"unorderedListMarker": "#79b8ff",
		"listPrefix": "#676f7d",
		"listGuide": "#3e444d",
		"taskCheckboxBackground": "var(--meo-surface-background)",
		"taskCheckboxBorder": "#b4bbc0",
		"taskCheckboxBorderHover": "#b4bbc0",
		"taskCheckboxCheck": "var(--vscode-editor-foreground)",
		"taskCheckboxDoneBackground": "#505862",
		"taskCheckboxDoneBorder": "#505862",
		"taskCheckboxDoneCheck": "var(--meo-background)",
		"taskCompleteForeground": "#676f7d",
		"taskDroppedForeground": "#676f7d",
		"blockquoteBorder": "#b4bbc0",
		"blockquoteForeground": "#b4bbc0",
		"horizontalRule": "#3e4246",
		"tableBorder": "#474b50",
		"tableHeaderBackground": "var(--meo-inset-background)",
		"tableSelectionBorder": "#61afef",
		"tableDelimiterForeground": "#3e4246",
		"imageBackground": "var(--meo-code-background)",
		"imageBorder": "#3e444d",
		"imageFallbackForeground": "#676f7d",
		"linkForeground": "#61afef",
		"wikiLinkForeground": "#61afef",
		"footnoteForeground": "#61afef",
		"footnoteBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-color-base05) 12%, transparent 88%)",
		"kbdBackground": "var(--meo-inset-background)",
		"kbdBorder": "#3e444d",
		"frontmatterKey": "#e5c07b",
		"frontmatterValue": "var(--vscode-editor-foreground)",
		"frontmatterPillBackground": "#3e444d",
		"searchMatchForeground": "var(--meo-background)",
		"searchMatchBackground": "#ffe600",
		"searchMatchBorder": "#ffe600",
		"searchMatchActiveForeground": "var(--meo-background)",
		"searchMatchActiveBackground": "#ff8c00",
		"searchMatchActiveBorder": "#ff8c00",
		"scrollbarThumb": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-foreground) 38%, transparent)",
		"scrollbarThumbHover": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-foreground) 50%, transparent)",
		"scrollbarThumbActive": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-foreground) 62%, transparent)",
		"alertNoteForeground": "#61afef",
		"alertNoteBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-semantic-alertNoteForeground) 8%, transparent)",
		"alertNoteBorder": "#61afef",
		"alertTipForeground": "#98c379",
		"alertTipBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-semantic-alertTipForeground) 8%, transparent)",
		"alertTipBorder": "#98c379",
		"alertImportantForeground": "#c678dd",
		"alertImportantBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-semantic-alertImportantForeground) 8%, transparent)",
		"alertImportantBorder": "#c678dd",
		"alertWarningForeground": "#e5c07b",
		"alertWarningBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-semantic-alertWarningForeground) 8%, transparent)",
		"alertWarningBorder": "#e5c07b",
		"alertCautionForeground": "#e06c75",
		"alertCautionBackground": "color-mix(in srgb, var(--meo-semantic-alertCautionForeground) 8%, transparent)",
		"alertCautionBorder": "#e06c75",
		"headingForeground": "#79b8ff",
		"markdownSyntax": "#8e999e"
	}
}

meoEnhanced.theme.description: Theme payload containing the editor background, base palette colors, independent semantic Markdown/UI colors, optional token overrides, and font settings.
meoEnhanced.theme.markdownDescription: [Select Theme](command:meoEnhanced.selectTheme) | [Import Theme](command:meoEnhanced.importTheme) | [Export Theme](command:meoEnhanced.exportTheme) | [Delete Imported Theme](command:meoEnhanced.deleteImportedTheme) | [Reset Theme to Default](command:meoEnhanced.resetThemeToDefault)

liveFontWeight.description: Live mode font weight override. Leave empty to use VS Code editor font weight.

sourceFontWeight.description: Source mode font weight override. Leave empty to use VS Code editor font weight.

semanticColors.description: Independent Markdown/UI colors. These override base palette-derived colors for specific editor parts.

codeBlockBackground.description: Fenced code block and Mermaid block background.

codeBlockActiveLineBackground.description: code block active line background color.

headingForeground.description: Heading content text color. Markdown markers such as #, **, and ~~ keep their marker colors.

markdownSyntax.description: Markdown syntax marker color, such as #, **, ~~, backticks, and fence markers.
